title: 中文操作、双语单证与盖章件修订
requirement: 币种、金额、品名及条款对应；保存签署版本，草稿不能冒充已签署。

environment.identity: local OIDC issuer of the test (RS256, typ at+jwt, JWKS by discovery); no real identity provider

actors.ai:agent.reader: AI 代理（候选，只读与导入）
actors.config.reviewer: 配置与交易档案发布人（独立复核）
actors.cost.checker: 核价复核（核实、评估、冻结）

chain: BRC-001: the S3 chain and D1 §5 steps 1–14 to shipment.1 of the four lines, released and confirmed
observed: 双语单证: CI CI-2026-00001 and the PL rendered in en and zh-CN from one content: number, currency USD, quantity 120 PCS, amounts (per line, totals 960.00), FCA 2020 and the payment stages correspond; labels 商业发票/卖方/币种/净额 and goods 棉制针织T恤衫 per language

盖章件: a signed copy of the draft → INVALID_STATE /args/version; after the issue the generated zh-CN bytes as the signed copy → INVALID_KNOWN_VALUE /args/file_id; the AI agent → PERMISSION_DENIED; the stamped zh-CN scan recorded once (bound to the zh-CN rendition's SHA-256), again answered without a second copy; another copy for zh-CN → INVALID_STATE /args/language
签署版本 (TRD): the sales contract SC-2026-00001 of order revision 1 carries the countersigned scan sc.countersigned (S3's order documents)

中文数据与错误文本: company 合成企业, customer address 合成买方地址/汉堡 and goods names stored and printed as written; each refusal of the case is a catalogued code with its HTTP status and Chinese text (4: INVALID_KNOWN_VALUE：已提供但非法的已知值; INVALID_STATE：当前状态不允许该动作; PERMISSION_DENIED：无权或 AI 执行人工命令；不泄露存在性)
not_executed: China customs (single window): submissions and receipts are recorded manually by the documentation clerk (CN-M01); the receipts' original texts are synthetic
the tax authority: invoices are synthetic scans imported and verified by tax.officer; refund declarations, approvals and payments are recorded from synthetic evidence
the bank: fund records are entered by treasury from synthetic bank advices
the carrier's, forwarder's and inspection agency's systems: bookings, B/Ls and reports are entered from EVD evidence
a real identity provider (the test's local OIDC issuer mints every token)
the user interface (中文操作 is outside the API repository)
中文操作 (the Chinese user interface): outside the API repository; the API answers stable codes and English reasons, the client shows the catalogue's Chinese text
